sloka: न स संकुचितः पंथा येन वाली हतो गतः ।समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालि पथम् अन्वगाः ॥४-३०-८०॥
transliteration: na sa saṁkucitaḥ paṁthā yena vālī hato gataḥ ।samaye tiṣṭha sugrīva mā vāli patham anvagāḥ ॥4-30-80॥

translations.english: 'O mighty warrior O dear, go to Sugriva and make him aware of the virulence of my anger and tell him:
